question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is "**keep.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Blank 5 in the sentence will explain how the stars continue there process of shining.
 
• Thus, "Keep" is the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
 
 
• It is a verb that means to maintain or retain something in a particular state or condition.(बनाए रखना)
 
• Example: "I need to keep my room clean and tidy."
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Blight" is a noun that means a plant disease, or something that spoils or damages something else.(तुषार)
 
• "Part" is a noun that means a piece or section of something, or a role or function in a situation.(भाग)
 
• "Force" is a noun or verb that means strength or power, or to make someone do something against their will.(बल)
